Name MeasurementNotification_{timeBaseName} Comment Notifies about the availability of a new recorded measurement data block belonging to the Time Base. IsService true Variation FOR timeBase : ECV . subEltList ( "StbM / StbMSynchronizedTimeBase" ); LET timeBaseName = timeBase . shortname (); timeBaseType = timeBase . subElt ( "StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseType" ). value (); precisionRecordingSupport = ECV . subElt ( "StbM / StbMGeneral / StbMTimeRecordingSupport" ); isPrecisionRecordingSupported = precisionRecordingSupport . isDefined () AND ( precisionRecordingSupport . value () == true ); hasRecordingCallback = timeBase . subElt ( "StbMTimeRecording / StbMSyncTimeRecordBlockCallback" ). isDefined (); isPrecisionRecordingEnabled = isPrecisionRecordingSupported AND timeBase . subElt ( " StbMTimeRecording" ). isDefined () AND (NOT hasRecordingCallback ); WHERE isPrecisionRecordingEnabled AND ( timeBaseType == " TBTYPE_SYNCHRONIZED" ); 0 E_OK Operation successful Possible Errors 1 E_NOT_OK Operation failed Operation SetSyncTimeRecordTable Comment Provides the recorded snapshot data Block of the table belonging to the Synchronized Time Base. Relates to SyncTimeRecordBlockCallback<TimeBase> Variation WHERE ( timeBaseType == "TBTYPE_SYNCHRONIZED" ); syncRecordTableBlock Type StbM_SyncRecordTableBlockType Direction IN Comment Block of the table Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK
